scene: The harbour mouth at dawn, mist on flat water, the old steam trawler pulling away from the quay

subjects.description: A young woman with long red braided hair and a dark green hooded wool cloak, hood up
subjects.position: centre-right, standing at the stern rail of the trawler
subjects.action: looking back at the town, one hand raised in a small wave
subjects.pose: full body, turned toward the camera, cloak stirring in the breeze

subjects.description: A heavy-set grey-bearded captain in a navy peacoat
subjects.position: far right, small, at the wheelhouse window

style: painterly cinematic concept art, soft brush texture, wide storyboard frame
lighting: low golden sunrise from the left, long soft shadows, mist glowing, cool shadows on the water
background: the town's slate roofs and church spire in silhouette, the lighthouse, gulls, a buoy
composition: wide shot, boat in the lower right quadrant, town on the left, horizon on the lower third
